title: Special Fried Rice
subtitle: A peppery takeout style special fried rice
intro: This recipe is by Jason Farmer, where he tasted fried rice from 30+ different takeaways and then distilled them into the following recipe for home use.
steps: Slice [b]Chicken[/b] and place into a bowl, add 1/2 tsp [b]Baking soda[/b], 1/2 tsp [b]Suger[/b], 1/2 tsp [b]Cornstarch[/b], 1/4 tsp [b]Salt[/b], 1/8 tsp [b]MSG[/b], and 1 tsp [b]Neutral Oil[/b]
Use day old [b]Rice[/b] or cook some off now for use later.
In a bowl mix together 1 tbps [b]Suger[/b], 4 tbsp [b]Light soy sauce[/b], and 1 tbsp [b]Dark soy sauce[/b].
In a separate bowl mix together 1/2 tbsp [b]MSG[/b], 1 tbsp [b]Salt[/b], 1/2 tbsp [b]White pepper[/b].

Heat wok or pan over medium high heat until lightly smoking, add 1 tbsp [b]Neutral oil[/b], turn heat to low and add [b]Eggs[/b] , scramble and remove from pan setting aside for later and wipe down the pan.
Return pan to medium heat, add 1 tbsp [b]Neutral oil[/b], add [b]Chicken[/b] and cook until 90% done about 2-3 minutes, remove [b]Chicken[/b] from pan and set aside and wipe down the pan.
Return pan to medium heat, add 1 tbsp [b]Neutral oil[/b], add [b]Onion[/b] and [b]Carrot[/b] and cook until [b]Onion[/b] is transparent about 1-2 minutes, add [b]Garlic[/b] and for cook 1 minute .
Add [b]Rice[/b] to the cooked vegetables breaking up any clumps and cook for 2-4 minutes, add the [b]Chicken[/b] & [b]Eggs[/b] and mix together well.
Push the [b]Rice[/b] to the center of the pan and add the sauce mix around the rim of the pan, stir until rice and sauce are fully incorporated.
Add the seasoning mix and stir into the [b]Rice[/b].
Add the [b]Scallions[/b] and [b]Bean sprouts[/b], mix together.
Push the [b]Rice[/b] to the center again and add the [b]Shaoxing[/b] wine to the rim of the pan, stir together.
Turn off the heat, add the [b]Toasted sesame oil[/b], mix together.
Adjust seasoning with [b]Salt[/b] and [b]White pepper[/b], Plate, top with [b]Sesame seeds[/b].
Serve.
note: Save some Scallion for a garnish along with the Sesame seeds

title: Alfredo Pasta Bake
subtitle: A creamy, garlic, and cheesy pasta bake
intro: A mouthwatering creamy garlic alfredo pasta bake, topped with crispy melted cheese by Tasty.
steps: In a pot, heat [b]Oil[/b] and add [b]Chicken[/b], season [b]Chicken[/b] with [b]Salt[/b] and [b]Pepper[/b], add [b]Garlic[/b], then brown the [b]Chicken[/b].
Add [b]Chicken stock[/b], [b]Double cream[/b], and [b]Pasta[/b], and bring to a boil, Cover and reduce the heat to a simmer for 15-20 min.
Turn off heat and stir in [b]Grated parmesan cheese[/b], Pour the [b]Pasta[/b] into your baking dish, Sprinkle evenly with [b]Grated mozzarella[/b].
Broil 10 - 15 minutes, or until the [b]Cheese[/b] is golden brown. Remove and sprinkle with fresh [b]Parsley[/b].
Serve.
note: Rest for at least 10 minutes to let the pasta and sauce set.

title: Chilli
subtitle: A satisfying, hearty beef and bean Chili recipe
intro: Preppy Kitchens Mouthwatering beef and bean chilli

ingredients.item: Red kidney beans - rinsed and drained

steps: Heat the [b]Oil[/b] in a large dutch oven over medium high heat, add the [b]Onion[/b] and [b]Bell pepper[/b].
Cook, stirring frequently, until slightly softened, about 5 minutes, add the [b]Garlic[/b] and cook for 1 more minute.
Add the [b]Mince beef[/b] and cook for about 5 minutes, breaking into small pieces with a wooden spoon until no longer pink.
Reduce the heat to medium, add the [b]Tomato paste[/b] and cook for 1 minute.
Add the [b]Chilli powder[/b], [b]Cumin[/b], [b]Oregano[/b], [b]Salt[/b], [b]Cayenne[/b], and [b]Black Pepper[/b], cook for 1 minute stirring frequently.
Add the [b]Cocoa powder[/b] and [b]Brown suger[/b], mix for 1 minute.
Stir in the [b]Diced tomatoes[/b], [b]Tomato passata[/b], [b]Kidney beans[/b], [b]Pinto beans[/b], and [b]Beef stock[/b], bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium low, and simmer uncovered for 30-45 minutes until the chilli thickens.
Season with more [b]Salt[/b] and [b]Black pepper[/b] to taste.
Plate and top with [b]Grated cheese[/b], [b]Sour cream[/b], [b]Scallions[/b], and [b]Doritos[/b].
Serve
note: can be nice with chips instead of rice, go easy on the Grated cheese as it can mute the flavour of the chilli, and the Doritos are pretty much a must with this dish

title: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
subtitle: A bowl of comfort food, its hearty, cheesy, and creamy
intro: It is so hearty and rich, as it’s loaded with broccoli and cheese.

ingredients.item: Broccoli florets - cut to bite size

steps: In a large Dutch oven, melt the [b]Butter[/b] over medium heat.
Add the [b]Onions[/b], [b]Carrots[/b], 1/2 tsp [b]Salt[/b], and [b]Pepper[/b], cook stirring occasionally until softened about 5 minuets.
Add the [b]Garlic[/b] and cook stirring often for 2 minuets
Add the [b]Flour[/b] and cook stirring constantly for 2 minuets
Gradually whisk in the [b]Chicken stock[/b] breaking up any lumps, then stir in the [b]Half & half[/b]
Increase the heat to medium high and bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally, once thickened, reduce heat to low.
Stir in the [b]Broccoli[/b], [b]Mustard powder[/b], [b]Paprika[/b], and remaining 1/2 tsp [b]Salt[/b].
Cover and cook at low simmer until the [b]Broccoli[/b] is tender, about 15 minuets
Stir in the [b]Grated cheese[/b] a handful at a time until smooth, taste and add more [b]Salt[/b] if desired.
Serve
note: Do not continue to cook on the heat once the cheese is added as it may become grainy in the soup.

title: Sesame Chicken
subtitle: Crunchy nutty little bites of chicken
intro: A delicious fried chicken coated in a sesame sauce best served with white rice

ingredients.item: Chicken breast - cut into 1.5 inch cubes

steps: Cut [b]Chicken breast[/b] into 1 inch size pieces, and place in bowl.

Marinate the [b]Chicken[/b] with 1 tsp [b]Garlic[/b], 1.5 tsp [b]Light soy sauce[/b], 1/2 tsp [b]Salt[/b], [b]Black pepper[/b] to taste, [b]Egg white[/b], 1/2 tbsp [b]Cornstarch[/b], mix together and leave for 40 minutes.
Add half the [b]Starch[/b] into a container, spread it out, add in the [b]Chicken[/b], add the other half of the [b]Starch[/b], and mix until the [b]Chicken[/b] is well coated.
Heat the [b]Oil[/b] up to 190c, add the [b]Chicken[/b] piece by piece and fry for about 2 minuets, take them out to rest for 15 minuets.
Keep the temperature at 190c and now do the second fry for the [b]Chicken[/b] for 2-3 minuets keeping an eye on the colour, take them out and set aside.

In a large bowl mix together the 3 tbsp [b]Brown suger[/b], 2 tbsp [b]Honey[/b], 2.5 tbsp [b]Light soy sauce[/b], 2.5 tbsp [b]Ketchup[/b], 3 tbsp [b]Water[/b], and 1 tbsp [b]Rice wine vinegar[/b], mix until well combined.
In a small bowl mix together your 2 tsp [b]Cornstarch[/b] and 2 tsp [b]Water[/b], mix together then set to the side.
Add the sauce mix to a pan and bring to a boil, once boiling add your starch slurry and mix to thicken the sauce so it coats the back of a spoon.
Add the [b]Chicken[/b] to the sauce along with a drizzle of [b]Sesame oil[/b], and the 1.5 tbsp [b]Sesame seeds[/b].
Toss everything until the [b]Chicken[/b] is coated well, take them out and garnish with diced [b]Scallion[/b].
Serve
note: This recipe is well served with a side of white rice.

title: Crunch Wrap
subtitle: A mouthwatering smash burger with a crunchy twist.
intro: A juicy smash burger served in a toasted wrap with, cheese, lettuce, caramelised onions, garlic mayo, and crunchy doritos.
steps: Slice your [b]Onions[/b]
Bring a pot to medium heat and add 1 tbsp [b]Butter[/b], once melted add in the [b]Onions[/b] and caramelise for 40 minuets or until the consistency you like, then remove from heat and set aside
Take a [b]Burger[/b] and tear it into pieces smashing them onto the top of a laid out [b]Wrap[/b], until it forms a thin layer.

In a pan on a medium high heat add 1/2 tbsp [b]Oil[/b] and then add the [b]Wrap[/b] meat side down and place a weight ontop and cook for 2-3 minutes until the [b]Burger[/b] meat is the colour you like.
Flip the [b]Wrap[/b] to crisp the other side, add a [b]Cheese slice[/b] and [b]Caramelised onions[/b] ontop of the meat to warm up, cook the wrap for 2 minuets then remove from heat.
Add a handful of [b]Shredded lettuce[/b], a dob of [b]Garlic mayo[/b], and then fold the warp in half forming a taco.
Add in the [b]Doritos[/b] and repeat these steps for the remaining Crunch wraps.
Serve
note: Caramelising the onions can take upto an hour but they add a lovely sweet taste the the wraps.

title: Katsu Curry
subtitle: Japanese curry with a juicy katsu filet
intro: The perfect combination of crispy chicken and Japanese curry served with a bowl of hot steamed rice
steps: Heat the saucepan, add the [b]Butter[/b] and [b]Oil[/b], then add the [b]Onion[/b] and fry until translucent.
Add the [b]Potato cubes[/b] and [b]Carrots[/b], stir for 1 minute then add the [b]Curry block[/b] and [b]Chicken stock[/b].
Stir well to combine all the ingredients together and cook until the vegetables are all tender, then remove from heat.
Wash and cook your [b]Rice[/b] while cooking the [b]Chicken[/b] in the next few steps.
Take your sliced [b]Chicken[/b] and season each side with [b]Salt[/b] & [b]Pepper[/b].
Place the [b]Flour[/b] and [b]Bread crumbs[/b] in separate bowls and whisk the [b]Egg[/b] in a third bowl.
Coat the [b]Chicken[/b] well in the [b]Flour[/b] shaking the excess off, then coat the [b]Chicken[/b] with the [b]Egg[/b] and then into the [b]Bread crumbs[/b].
Deep fry at 176c till both sides are golden, transfer to a cooling rack, then cut into slices.
Place over a bed of [b]Rice[/b] and pour the [b]Curry[/b] onto one side of the plate.
Serve
note: Try to time it so that your rice is cooking as you fry the chicken so that it will still be hot for serving.

title: Garlic Fried Rice
subtitle: Benihanas hibachi fried rice reverse engineered for the home kitchen.
intro: A home kitchen version of benihanas fried rice, its a delicious fried rice made with a garlic butter.
steps: Make the [b]Garlic butter[/b] by taking the [b]Butter[/b] heating it till it is soft, grate in the 4 [b]Garlic cloves[/b], and add the 1 tsp [b]Light soy sauce[/b], and mix together and leave to the side.
Heat a bit of [b]Oil[/b] in a large pan over medium heat, season the [b]Chicken cutlets[/b] on both sides and cook until done, about 2-3 minuets, remove to a cutting board.
Slice the [b]Chicken[/b] into 1/2cm size cubes, then return to the pan with 1 tsp [b]Garlic butter[/b], until it melts and coats the [b]Chicken[/b], transfer to a bowl.

Wipe the pan out and add 2 tsp [b]Oil[/b], once hot add the [b]Whisked eggs[/b] and beat as it is added to create ribbons, once all the [b]Egg[/b] is cooked, remove from heat and add to the [b]Chicken[/b] bowl.

Wipe out the pan again, return to medium heat, add a bit of [b]Oil[/b], once hot add the [b]Onion[/b] & [b]Carrot[/b] and cook for 2-3 minuets, then add to the bowl with the [b]Chicken[/b] and [b]Eggs[/b].
Wipe out the pan a final time and return to a medium heat, add 1 tbsp [b]Oil[/b], once hot add the [b]Cooked rice[/b], breaking up any chunks and cooking for 2-3 minuets.
Add the bowl of [b]Chicken, Eggs, and Vegetables[/b] as well as 1 tbsp of the [b]Garlic butter[/b], and [b]Salt & Pepper[/b] to taste, cook for 1 minuet.
Push the [b]Rice[/b] to one side of the pan and add the [b]Soy sauce[/b] directly to the pan, once the [b]Soy sauce[/b] sizzles stir it into the rice.
Mix together until there is no [b]White rice[/b], kill the heat, add the [b]Sesame seeds[/b], stir until combined, plate, and garnish with more [b]Sesame seeds[/b] and [b]Scallions[/b].
Serve
note: best to cook 2 servings at a time so you dont over crowed the pan.

title: Garlic Parmesan Chips
subtitle: Mouthwatering garlic, cheesy chips
intro: With double fried fresh cut fries tossed in a mixture or finely chopped garlic and parsley, along with freshly grated Parmesan cheese, you'll never go back to boring fries again

ingredients.item: Neutral oil - if deep frying chips

steps: Cook your [b]Chips[/b] until done and the desired colour, set aside in a large mixing bowl.
In another bowl soften the [b]Butter[/b] in the microwave, then add chopped or grated [b]Garlic[/b], and 1 tsp [b]Light soy sauce[/b], and mix till combined.
Add the [b]Grated Parmesan[/b] and [b]Garlic butter[/b] to the bowl with the [b]Chips[/b] and gently mix together.
Adjust taste with [b]Salt & Pepper[/b].
Serve
note: Great with frozen chips or fresh homemade ones. the chips can be cooked in the oven, air fryer, or deep fryer whatever you prefer.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
subtitle: Tender chicken glazed in rich, sticky teriyaki sauce, bursting with flavour.
intro: Succulent chicken coated in a glossy teriyaki glaze, perfectly sweet, savoury, and irresistible.

ingredients.item: Sesame seeds - with extra for garnish

steps: In a bowl soften the [b]Butter[/b] in a microwave, then add [b]Grated garlic[/b], and 1 tsp [b]Light soy sauce[/b], and mix together then set aside.
In a small bowl or ramekin, mix together the 2 tsp [b]Cornstarch[/b] and 2 tsp [b]Water[/b], then set aside.

In a saucepan add the 70ml [b]Light soy sauce[/b], 35ml [b]Sake[/b], 70ml [b]Mirin[/b], 1.5 tbsp [b]Ketchup[/b], 15ml [b]Apple juice[/b], a pinch of [b]Black pepper[/b], and 60g [b]Suger[/b] and mix together.
Heat the saucepan with the sauce mix on a medium heat, and simmer for approximately 10 minuets to cook off the alcohol.
Add the [b]Cornstarch slurry[/b] and whisk constantly for 1-2 minuets or until the sauce reaches your desired thickness, remove from heat, set aside and let cool.
Rinse and wash your [b]Rice[/b], and set to cook in your rice cooker.
Heat some [b]Oil[/b] in a pan at medium heat and take the [b]Chicken cutlets[/b] and fry them on both sides until browned about 4 minuets per side, then set aside.
Wipe the pan out, add some [b]Oil[/b] and bring to a medium heat, then add the sliced [b]Mushrooms[/b] with a sprinkle of [b]Salt[/b] and cook until the [b]Mushrooms[/b] are golden, then set aside.
Take the rested [b]Chicken[/b] and slice it into strips, wipe out the pan and return to medium heat, then add the [b]Chicken slices[/b] and [b]Mushrooms[/b] along with the [b]Garlic butter[/b].
Once the [b]Garlic butter[/b] has melted and coated the chicken pour in the [b]Teriyaki sauce[/b].
When the [b]Teriyaki sauce[/b] is heated through, turn off the heat and stir in [b]Sesame seeds[/b].
Plate and sprinkle additional [b]Sesame seeds[/b] on top for garnish
Serve
note: The sugar in teriyaki sauce scorches quickly, so don't leave it on heat any longer than needed.

title: Korean Popcorn Chicken
subtitle: Crispy chicken, Korean glaze, seriously addictive.
intro: Crispy popcorn chicken tossed in a bold Korean glaze, delivering the perfect balance of sweet, spicy, and savoury.

ingredients.item: Garlic powder - or extra minced garlic

steps: Cut the [b]Chicken[/b] into bite size pieces, add to a bowl.

In a pan combine 2 tbsp [b]Grated garlic[/b], 1 tbsp [b]Soy sauce[/b], 2 tbsp [b]Suger[/b], 2 tbsp [b]Ketchup[/b], 4 tbsp [b]Corn syrup[/b], 3 tbsp [b]Water[/b], 1 tbsp [b]Gochujang[/b], and set aside.
Heat your [b]Oil[/b] to 180c while you do the next steps.

To the bowl add, 1 tsp [b]Salt[/b], 2 tsp [b]Black pepper[/b], 1/2 tsp [b]Grated ginger[/b], 1 tsp [b]Chilli powder[/b], 1/2 tbsp [b]Grated garlic[/b], 1 tbsp [b]Cooking wine[/b] or mirin, mix together and let it rest in the fridge for a minimum 15 minuets.

In a bowl mix together, 200g [b]Flour[/b], 50g [b]Cornstarch[/b], 1 tsp [b]Baking powder[/b], 1.5 tsp [b]Salt[/b], 1 tsp [b]Black Pepper[/b], 1 tsp [b]Chilli powder[/b], 1/2 tbsp [b]Oregano[/b], 1/2 tbsp [b]Garlic powder[/b] (if you use minced garlic, add it when you add an egg).
Split the [b]Flour mix[/b] 55%/45% into two bowls, in to the 45% add one [b]Egg[/b], and add the 120ml [b]Water[/b] in parts while mixing together to form a slightly runny batter.
Add 10-13 pieces of your chicken to the wet batter and coat it, then add them into the dry flour mix and coat it well pressing a little.

Check your [b]Oil[/b] is the right temperature, then add in the coated [b]Chicken[/b] and fry for 1-2 minuets when its light browned, leave to rest on a rack or plate while you repeat with the remaining [b]Chicken[/b] pieces.
Take your [b]Sauce mix[/b] and mix together on a low heat, bring to a simmer and reduce it until your desired thickness.
Optional - you can give your [b]Chicken[/b] a second fry for extra crunch, just fry it again at 180c for 1-2 minuets.
Plate the [b]Chicken popcorn[/b] and then drizzle the [b]Sauce[/b] over it, or serve in a ramekin to dip in, garnish with [b]Grated cheese[/b] and [b]Parsley[/b]
Serve
note: This served with the Garlic Parmesan Chips is a meal to die for.

title: Coconut Rice
subtitle: Mums favourite type of rice
intro: Fluffy jasmine rice infused with creamy coconut, adding a subtle sweetness to every bite.

ingredients.item: Rice - can be a blend or jasmine and long grain

steps: Rinse and wash your [b]Rice[/b], add to the rice cooker with the 2 cans [b]Coconut milk[/b], and any water to bring the liquid level to the correct amount.
Add the 2 tbsp [b]Suger[/b], and turn the cooker on, after 5-10 minuets when the water is hot add the [b]Salt[/b] for the rice.
Check on the [b]Rice[/b] every 5 minuets to make sure it is not sticking to the bottom of the cooker.
Once cooked, plate and top with a crack of [b]Black Pepper[/b].
Serve
note: Can stick and burn to the bottom of the rice cooker so make sure to stir regularly.

title: Chicken Fricassee
subtitle: French creamy chicken stew
intro: Tender chicken simmered in a rich, creamy, mushroom sauce with aromatic herbs and mash potato.
steps: Get your [b]Potatoes[/b] peeled and quartered, and set them in a pot with water covering the top [b]potatoes[/b], set on a high temperature and once the pot is boiling set a 6 minute timer, check if the potatoes are cooked or if they need another 2-3 minuets.
Once your [b]Potatoes[/b] are cooked you can drain the water from the pot, then set the potatoes back in the warm pot and set aside.
Pat [b]Chicken[/b] dry and sprinkle with [b]Salt[/b] and [b]Pepper[/b].
Melt [b]Butter[b] over a medium high heat in a large skillet, add the [b]Chicken[/b] and cook on each side for 4-5 minutes until the internal temperature is 74c, then remove to a plate.
Add 300g [b]Mushrooms[/b], 2 [b]Onions[/b], 1 [b]Bay leaf[/b], and 1/2 tsp [b]Dried thyme[/b], cook for 5 minuets until [b]Mushrooms[/b] is lightly golden.
Add [b]Grated garlic[/b] and stir for 30 seconds, add the 3 tbsp [b]Flour[/b] and cook for 1 minuet.
Add 125ml [b]White wine[/b], 750ml [b]Chicken stock[/b], and 1/2 tsp [b]Salt[/b] & 1/2 tsp [b]Pepper[/b], stir scraping the base of the pot to dissolve the fond.
Bring the [b]Sauce[/b] to a simmer and reduce uncovered for 15 minutes, then add the [b]Chicken[/b] and simmer with lid on for 6 minutes or until internal temperatures reaches 65c
While the [b]Chicken[/b] comes up to temperature you can add [b]Salt[/b], [b]Butter[/b], and [b]Parsely[/b] to your [b]Potatoes[/b] and then mash them, divide the [b]Mash[/b] between the plates.

Once the [b]Chicken[/b] is up to temperature remove the [b]Chicken[/b] to the plates with the mash, add the [b]Double cream[/b] to the sauce and stir, once it comes to a simmer, taste and adjust with [b]Salt[/b] and [b]Pepper[/b].
Return the [b]Chicken[/b] to the sauce, and coat it in it, sprinkle with [b]Parsley[/b], plate the [b]Chicken[/b] and [b]Sauce[/b].
Serve
note: You can replace the white wine with more chicken stock.

title: Chow Mein
subtitle: Wok-tossed noodles, crisp vegetables, savoury sauce.
intro: Golden noodles stir-fried with fresh vegetables in a rich, savoury sauce for the perfect satisfying bite
steps: Prep your [b]Red onion[/b], [b]Carrots[/b], and [b]Cabbage[/b], into thin strips, and dice your [b]Scallions[/b].
Prep your [b]Chicken[/b] by slicing it into thin strips, then place it into a bowl.
Marinade the [b]Chicken[/b] in 1 tbsp [b]Oyster sauce[/b], 3 tsp [b]Cornstarch[/b], 3 tbsp [b]Water[/b], and 1/2 tsp [b]White pepper[/b], mix together well, then marinate for at least 30 minuets
In a bowl combine 4 tbsp [b]Oyster sauce[/b], 4 tbsp [b]Light soy sauce[/b], 1 tbsp [b]Dark soy sauce[/b], 2 tsp [b]Suger[/b], and 2 tsp [b]Chicken bouillon powder[/b], and set aside.
While doing the next steps have your Noodles in a bowl and cover with a kettle of boiling water and leave for 6 minuets or until the noodles are cooked, drain them and leave aside.
Add 2 tbsp [b]Oil[/b] to a wok or frying pan and add the [b]Marinated chicken[/b], cook on a medium high heat for 3-5 minuets or the [b]Chicken[/b] is cooked through, remove and set aside.
Add the [b]Onions[/b], [b]Carrots[/b], and [b]Cabbage[/b] and cook on medium heat until softened about 3-5 minuets, remove and set aside.

Add 1 tbsp [b]Oil[/b] and the cooked [b]Noodles[/b] to the pan on high heat and stir and flip for around 1 minuet, turn the heat to low, give your [b]Sauce mix[/b] a stir and then add to the pan with the noodles, stir until the sauce is well distributed.

Add the [b]Cooked chicken[/b] and [b]Cooked veg[/b] and stir mixing well for 1 minuet, turn the heat to medium high and add the 110g [b]Bean sprouts[/b] and [b]Scallions[/b], and stir for 1 minuet, finish with a drizzle of 1 tbsp [b]Sesame oil[/b] and plate.
Serve
note: Great with store bought prawn crackers and a sprinkle of sesame seeds

title: Garlic Naan Breads
subtitle: Soft, fluffy naan with garlic butter.
intro: Freshly baked naan brushed with fragrant garlic butter and herbs.

ingredients.item: flour + a few more tbsp if dough is sticky

steps: In a bowl combine 7g [b]Dry yeast[/b], 1 tsp [b]Suger[/b], and 2 tbsp [b]Warm Water[/b], mix and leave for 10 minuets, if the yeast has proofed, continue, if not start again with new yeast.
In a mixing bowl add your 360g [b]Flour[/b], 80g [b]Plain yoghurt[/b], 1.5 tsp [b]Salt[/b], 60ml [b]Olive oil[/b], 190ml [b]Warm water[/b], and [b]Proofed yeast[/b].

Using a stand mixer or by hand mixed the bowl together until it forms a [b]Dough[/b], the [b]Doagh[/b] shouldn't stick to your hands if it does add more flour a tbsp at a time and mix then check again if its sticky, continue once its not sticking.
[b]Oil[/b] a bowl and set your [b]Dough[/b] in it covering with a towel or lid, and leave to prove in a slightly warm place for 1 hour or till it doubles in size.

While you wait for the [b]Doagh[/b] to rise make the garlic butter, in a bowl take the 115g [b]Butter[/b] and soften it in the microwave, then add the [b]Grated garlic[/b], and [b]Chopped parsley[/b], mix together and leave to the side.

Once doubled in size divide your [b]Doagh[/b] into 7-8 even size balls, on a plate add some [b]Oil[/b] then place a [b]Doagh ball[/b] onto it and flatten it out with your hands into a disc to your desired thickness.

Take the [b]Naan[/b] you flattened and add to a hot frying pan with a little [b]Oil[/b] on high heat for until the bottom is golden brown then flip and do the same on the other side, remove to a plate once both sides are cooked.
Take a pastry brush and brush your freshly cooked [b]Naan[/b] with the [b]Garlic butter[/b] you made earlier.
Repeat steps 7 & 8 for the remaining [b]doagh balls[/b].
Serve
note: A fantastic side for other dishes such as curries or lasagne.

title: Jack's 'Quick' Lasagne
subtitle: 'Quick' Lasagne in 2 hours
intro: Layers of rich beef ragu, creamy béchamel and melted cheese, baked until golden and bubbling.
steps: Dice the [b]Onions[/b] and [b]Carrots[/b], and set to the side.
Heat a large pot to medium high heat, if your mince isn't fatty add 1 tbsp [b]Oil[/b] to the pot, add the [b]Beef mince[/b] and dont touch for 4-5 minutes.
After the time has passed you may break up your [b]Beef mince[/b] to a consistency you like, and cook it off until no pink bits remain.

Reduce the heat to medium and push the [b]Beef mince[/b] to one side of the pan and add in the [b]Onions[/b] and [b]Carrots[/b], season with 1 tsp [b]Salt[/b] and 1 tsp [b]Black pepper[/b], and cook until softened about 4-5 minutes.
Stir in the 2-3 tbsp [b]Red curry paste[/b] stir until combined and fragrant, then add the [b]Tomato passata[/b], mix well and bring to a gentle simmer.

While the [b]Ragu[/b] simmers, preheat the oven to 180c, in another pot take 80g [b]Butter[/b] and melt it, once melted add the 80g [b]Flour[/b], stirring constantly for 1 minute to cook out the [b]Flour[/b], then add the 800ml [b]Milk[/b] gradually while stirring.

Once all the [b]Milk[/b] has been incorporated bring the [b]bechamel[/b] to a simmer and let thicken until your desired consistency, then add in the 100g [b]Grated cheese[/b] and 1-2 tsp [b]Nutmeg[/b], mix until combined, then remove from heat.

In a casserole dish add a small amount of the [b]Ragu[/b] so the bottom isn't dry, then form a layer of [b]Lasagne sheets[/b], followed by a layer of [b]Ragu[/b], then a layer of [b]Bechamel[/b], then repeat these layers building your [b]Lasagne[/b], saving a couple tbsp of the [b]Ragu[/b] and [b]Bechamel[/b].

Top the final layer of [b]Lasagne sheets[/b] with the left over [b]Ragu[/b] and [b]Bechamel[/b], then do a top layer of [b]Grated cheese[/b], and place in the oven for 20-25 minutes for the cheese to broil.
Serve
note: A lovely 'Quick' Lasagne that can be served with a side of Chips or Garlic Naan breads.

title: Fami-Chicki
subtitle: Juicy, Crunchy, Chicken Burgers
intro: Crispy, juicy Japanese-style fried chicken seasoned with a savoury blend of spices
steps: Trim any excess fat from the [b]Chicken breast[/b], and butterfly them into 4 [b]Cutlets[/b].

In a bowl, prepare the dry dredge by mixing together the 200g [b]Flour[/b], 200g [b]Cornstarch[/b], ½ tbsp [b]Hot sauce[/b], ½ tsp [b]White pepper[/b], 1 tsp [b]Garlic powder[/b], 1 tsp [b]Onion powder[/b], ½ tsp [b]Chilli powder[/b], and ½ tsp [b]Salt[/b].

In a separate bowl, prepare the wet batter by whisking together the 2 [b]Eggs[/b], ½ tbsp [b]Hot sauce[/b], ½ tsp [b]White pepper[/b], 1 tsp [b]Garlic powder[/b], 1 tsp [b]Onion powder[/b], ½ tsp [b]Chilli powder[/b], and ½ tsp [b]Salt[/b].
Pour 2-3 tablespoons of the wet mixture into the dry dredge and mix well. This creates small clumps that will give extra crispiness to the final fried chicken.
Preheat the oil to 180°C in a deep pan or fryer.

Dredge each [b]Chicken cutlet[/b] in the dry mixture, shaking off any excess, then dip into the wet batter, allowing any excess to drip off. Return each [b]Cutlet[/b] to the dry dredge for a final coat, and place on a tray with a wire rack until ready to cook

Carefully place the [b]Chicken[/b] into the hot [b]Oil[/b] without overcrowding the pan. Fry for 8–10 minutes, or until the [b]chicken[/b] is golden brown and cooked through. To check for doneness, the internal temperature should reach 70°C / 160°F in the thickest part of the chicken.
Place the fried chicken on a wire rack to drain, sprinkle with a little extra salt if desired.
Serve
note: A great fried chicken recipie for making homemade chicken burgers.

title: Chicken Balls
subtitle: The Ultimate Chinese Chicken Balls
intro: Crispy golden chicken balls coated in a light, savoury batter and fried until deliciously tender.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast - cut into 1 inch cubes

steps: Cut the [b]Chicken breast[/b] into 1" dices. Place them in a large mixing bowl and add 1 tsp [b]Salt[/b], 2 tsp [b]Sugar[/b], 1/2 tsp [b]White pepper[/b], 1 tsp [b]sesame oil[/b], 1 tbsp [b]Grated garlic[/b], 1 tsp [b]Corn starch[/b], and 1/2 tsp [b]Baking soda[/b], Mix well, set aside, and marinate for 15-30 minutes. ( If you have more time you can leave it for 1 hour. )

In a small saucepan, combine all the sweet and sour sauce ingredients, 4 tbsp [b]Ketchup[/b], 4 tbsp [b]White vinegar[/b], 3 tbsp [b]Sugar[/b], 1 tbsp [b]Tomato puree[/b], 140ml [b]Water[/b], 1 tsp [b]Cornstarch[/b] and 1/2 tsp [b]Salt[/b].
Mix well until corn starch dissolved, then turn on the heat to low-medium. Stir continuously until the sauce is thicken to desire consistency. Turn off the heat and let it cool down.

Combine 120g [b]Flour[/b], 60g [b]Cornstarch[/b], 1 tsp [b]Baking soda[/b], and 1/2 tsp [b]Salt[/b] in a large bowl. Pour the 280ml [b]Water[/b] in, whisk well and make it into smooth batter. ( The batter should be medium thick. Add more water if needed. )
Add 60g of [b]Cornstarch[/b] in the chicken marinade, coat each chicken piece with the [b]Cornstarch[/b]. Then dip into the batter and turn to coat evenly.

Fry the [b]battered chicken pieces[/b] with pre-heated high heat [b]Oil[/b] for 2-3 minutes until light brown. ( about 180° C ) Remove from [b]Oil[/b] and set aside for 4-5 minutes. Repeat the process to remaining chicken pieces.
Then reheat the [b]Oil[/b] back to 180° C , fry the [b]Chicken[/b] 2nd time for 2-3 minutes until crispy golden brown. Remove from oil and transfer to cooling rack or paper towel.
Serve
note: Do not overcrowd the oil because overcrowding can drop down the oil temperature and the chicken balls can get greasy. Fry with batches if needed.

title: BIR Korma
subtitle: Rich, creamy, aromatic British Indian korma.
intro: A creamy, mildly spiced curry with aromatic flavours.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast - cut into large chunks

steps: This recipe is only for the [b]Chicken Korma[/b] itself and not any sides such as [b]Rice[/b] or [b]Chips[/b]
In a large bowl add the 600g [b]Diced chicken[/b], then add the 75g [b]Plain yoghurt[/b], 2 tsp [b]Gram flour[/b], 1 tsp [b]Salt[/b], 2 tsp [b]Ginger puree[/b], and 2 tsp [b]Garlic puree[/b].
Mix well together and leave the [b]Chicken[/b] to marinate for at least an hour in the fridge.
Heat a saucepan to medium heat, then add 60g [b]Butter[/b], once melted add the 2.5cm [b]Cinnamon stick[/b], and [b]Sliced onion[/b], then stir gently for 5 minuets until the [b]Onion[/b] is cooked.
Once the onion is softened add 1 tsp [b]Turmeric powder[/b], 1 tsp [b]Chilli powder[/b], 3 tbsp [b]Coriander powder[/b], and mix together for 1 minuet.
Now add the [b]Marinated chicken[/b] and as much of the [b]Marinade[/b] as you can, and cook on medium high for 4-5 minuets stirring often until the [b]Chicken[/b] is no longer pink.

Add the 300ml [b]Warm water[/b] to the pan and lower to a medium heat, add 6 tsp [b]Coconut flour[/b], and 4 tsp [b]Suger[/b], mix well together and bring to a boil, then simmer on a low heat with the lid on for 15 minuets.
Take a bowl and add the 50g [b]Cashew nuts[/b] and cover them in boiling water for 10-15 minuets, then add them to a blender and puree them, then add 150ml [b]Double cream[/b] and blend together.
Once the [b]Korma[/b] is done simmering add the [b]Cashew cream puree[/b] and mix together until fully incorporated, and remove the [/b]Cinnamon stick[/b].
Now add 1 tsp [b]Cardamon powder[/b], and 1 tsp [b]Garam masala[/b], mix well, then remove from the heat
Serve
note: Goes great witch Rice or Chips as well as Naan Breads.

title: Pancakes
subtitle: Fluffy, golden pancakes.
intro: Light, fluffy american style pancakes.
steps: In a large bowl whisk together the 360g [b]Flour[/b], 50g [b]Suger[/b], 1.5 tsp [b]Salt[/b], 1.5 tsp [b]Baking soda[/b], and 1 tbsp [b]Baking powder[/b].
In a separate large bowl combine the 600ml [b]Butter milk[/b], 55ml [b]Oil[/b], 1 tbsp [b]Vanilla extract[/b], and 3 [b]Eggs[/b].
Pour the [b]Wet mix[/b] into the [b]Dry mix[/b], and fold in maybe 20-25 times max, it should be lumpy [/b]Don't mix anymore[/b].

Heat a pan to a medium high heat and add a small dollop of [b]Butter[/b] to grease the pan, once melted add a large dessert spoon size dollop of the [b]Pancake batter[/b] to the pan and cook until you see bubbles popping all around the [b]Pancake[/b], then flip over, the bottom will be cooked when you can press on the [b]Pancake[/b] and it springs back.
Plate the cooked [b]Pancake[/b] and repeat for the remaining [b]Pancake batter[/b].
Serve
note: Delicious served with Bacon.

title: Italian Garlic Soup
subtitle: Simple ingredients, extraordinary flavour
intro: A comforting, aromatic soup packed with rich savoury flavour

ingredients.item: Rustic bread - or store bought Croutons

steps: Peel and chop the [b]Onion[/b] medium finely, Set aside, Peel the [b]Garlic cloves[/b], set aside, Wash and chop the [b]Leek[/b], set aside.
In a heavy pot or saucepan over medium heat, add 120ml [b]Olive oil[/b].  Add the chopped [b]Onion[/b], [b]Leek[/b] and [b]Dried thyme[/b], leave to sweat, do not brown.
Add the [b]Garlic[/b] and turn heat to low.  Cook gently for about 15 minutes.
While that’s cooking, peel and dice the [b]Potatoes[/b] then add to the pot along with all the [b]Chicken stock[/b].  Season with [b]Salt & Pepper[/b], simmer gently for 25 – 30 minutes
Add the [b]Cream[/b], mix well then blitz in a blender or use a stick blender directly in the pot.  Taste for seasoning.

For the [b]Croutons[/b], use store bought, or simply dice up some of the [b]Bread[/b] and fry in [b]Olive oil[/b] on low heat until brown and crispy, the slower you cook them, the more crispy they will remain in the soup.
Top the [b]Soup[/b] with the [b]Croutons[/b] and chopped [b]Parsley[/b].
Serve
note: Make your own croutons or use store bought ones.

title: Rose Pasta
subtitle: simple, comforting, and incredibly flavorful
intro: Creamy rose pasta is a dreamy combination of rich Alfredo and tangy marinara sauces, creating a smooth, velvety texture with a beautiful pink hue.
steps: Prepare ingredients by dicing the [b]Onion[/b], mincing 6 [b]Garlic cloves[/b], and grating 60g [b]Parmesan[/b].
In a large skillet, heat [b]Olive oil[/b] over medium heat. Add the chopped [b]Onions[/b] and sauté for about 5 minutes, until they’re soft and lightly golden.
Add in the minced [b]Garlic[/b] and [b]Red pepper flakes[/b], cooking for 30-60 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in 350ml [b]Passata[/b] and 90ml [b]Water[/b], then season with [b]Salt[/b], [b]Pepper[/b], and [b]Sugar[/b]. Stir well, cover and simmer on medium/medium-low heat for 15-20 minutes.

While the [b]Sauce[/b] simmers, cook your [b]Pasta[/b] in a pot of boiling salted water according to the package instructions. Don’t forget to reserve about 70ml of [b]Pasta water[/b] before draining.
Once the [b]Sauce[/b] is ready, stir in the [b]Double cream[/b] and simmer uncovered on medium heat for about 5 minutes to let it thicken slightly.
Add in [b]Spinach[/b] and reserved [b]Pasta water[/b] to the skillet. Stir gently then cover with a lid and cook for 3-5 minutes on medium heat, until the [b]Spinach[/b] wilts

Add the cooked [b]Pasta[/b] along with the grated [b]Parmesan[/b] to the [b]Sauce[/b]. Toss everything together until the [b]Pasta[/b] is evenly coated with the creamy [b]Rose sauce[/b] and simmer together for 1 minute.
Garnish with [b]Fresh basil[/b], a crack of [b]Black pepper[/b] and additional [b]Parmesan[/b].
Serve
note: Good by itself, but goes great with some fried chicken.

title: Chicken Pie
subtitle: Comforting, cozy, homemade chicken pie
intro: A comforting chicken pie filled with creamy, savoury goodness.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180c.

Cover the bottom of your pie dish with a sheet of [b]Puff pastry[/b], trimming any excess, then place a sheet of parchment paper ontop of the [b]Pastry[/b] and cover with baking beans, blind bake in an oven for 20 minuets. then remove and set aside
Butterfly your [b]Chicken breasts[/b] so that they are roughly even thickness, then set a frying pan to medium high heat.
Once hot add 1 tbsp [b]Neutral oil[/b] to the pan, then add the [b]Chicken breasts[/b] and cook on each side for 4 minutes or until the internal temperature is 74c, remove from pan and set aside.

In a large skillet, melt the [b]Butter[/b] over medium-high heat. Add the [b]Onion[/b], [b]Carrots[/b], [b]Celery[/b], and [b]Garlic[/b]. Cook for 5 minutes or until the [b]Carrots[/b] start to soften, stirring frequently.
Stir in the [b]Flour[/b]. Cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.

While stirring, slowly pour in the warm [b]Stock[/b] and [b]Double cream[/b]. Stir in the 1/2 tsp [b]Dried thyme[/b], 1 tsp [b]Salt[/b], and 1 tsp [b]Pepper[/b]. Reduce the heat to low and bring to a simmer. Cook just until the [b]Sauce[/b] is thickened, about 5 minutes.
While the [b]Sauce[/b] thickens shred the [b]Chicken[/b], then Stir in the [b]Chicken[/b] and [b]Peas[/b]. Remove from the heat and transfer the filling into a bowl to cool for 20 minutes.

Once the [b]Filling[/b] is cool enough, add it to your pie dish and spread evenly, then take a second sheet of [b]Puff pastry[/b] and cover the top of the pie, crimping the sides, and cutting some steam vents into the top.
Brush the top of the pie with some [b]Double cream[/b] and then place the pie in the oven for 20 minuets or until your happy with how the top looks, then remove from the oven.
Let the pie rest for at least 20 minuets before plating
Serve
note: Goes well with a side of buttery mash or chips.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
subtitle: Crispy exterior, gooey interior, perfect cookies
intro: Chocolate chip cookies are soft, sweet treats filled with delicious, melty chocolate chips.
steps: Preheat oven to 175c, line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
In a bowl whisk together 360g [b]Powdered suger[/b], 43g [b]Cocoa powder[/b], and 1/2 tsp [b]Salt[/b].
Add to a separate bowl the 3 [b]Egg whites[/b], and the 1 tsp [b]Vanilla[/b], and whisk together, then add to the dry ingredient bowl, stir together until you have a glossy batter.
Stir in the 60g [b]Chocolate chips[/b].
Portion 2 tbsp per cookie on the tray, leaving space between as they will spread.
Bake for 10 minutes, the tops should be shiny and cracked.
Cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move to a rack.
Serve

title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars
subtitle: soft and chewy chocolate chip cookie bars
intro: full of chocolatey goodness with notes of brown sugar, vanilla, and salt.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180c. Line an 8×8-inch baking pan fully with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk to combine the 270g [b]Flour[/b], 1 tbsp [b]Cornstarch[/b], 1 tsp [b]Baking soda[/b], and 1 tsp [b]Salt[/b]. Set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the 170g [b]Melted butter[/b], the 220g [b]Brown sugar[/b], and 133g [b]White suger[/b]. Whisk together for about 30 seconds to form a somewhat thick slurry.
Add the 2 [b]Eggs[/b] and 1 tbsp [b]Vanilla[/b] to the [b]Butter mixture[/b] and whisk well for about 1 minute to combine.

Add the [b]Flour mixture[/b] to the [b]Butter mixture[/b] and stir together with a silicone spatula until almost fully combined. Reserve about ¼ cup of [b]Chocolate chips[/b], and stir the remaining into the dough.
Dollop the [b]Dough[/b] into the prepared baking pan. Using an offset spatula, spread into an even layer, leaving some texture on top. Sprinkle with the reserved [b]Chocolate chips[/b].

Bake until the edges are set and golden brown, and a toothpick or skewer inserted into the center comes out with a few moist crumbs. For gooier cookie bars, bake for 35-45 minutes. For firmer bars with crispy, edges bake for up to 55 minutes.
Let the cookie bars cool in the pan for about an hour before removing and cutting.
Serve
note: A sprinkle of flaky sea salt on top just after baking provides a nice bit of contrast for a salty-sweet chocolate chip cookie flavor.

title: Thai Cashew Chicken
subtitle: Savory chicken with crunchy cashews.
intro: Thai cashew chicken is a flavorful stir-fry with tender chicken, crunchy cashews, and fresh vegetables in a savory sauce.
steps: This recipe does not include any sides but this dish goes great with chip or noodles.
Chop the [b]Chicken[/b] into bite size pieces and marinate in the 1 tbsp [b]Light soy sauce[/b] and 1 tsp [b]White pepper[/b] and leave to marinate for 15 minutes.
To the [b]Chicken[/b] add the 50g [b]Flour[/b] mix till all the [b]Chicken[/b] is coated and set aside.

Heat a frying pan to medium high heat and add the 120ml [b]Neutral oil[/b], then add the 200g [b]Cashew nuts[/b] and fry until golden, but be careful not to burn them, remove them from the [b]Oil[/b] and set aside.
To the now flavoured [b]Oil[/b] add the [b]Coated chicken[/b], and fry for 4-5 minutes until the [b]Chicken[/b] is fully cooked, remove from the pan and set aside.
To the pan add the sliced [b]Peppers[/b] and [b]Onions[/b], fry for 3 minutes, add the [b]Grated garlic[/b] and fry for 1 minute.

To the pan add the sliced [b]Scallions[/b] and cook for 1 minute, then add the [b]Cooked chicken[/b] and add the 1.5 tbsp [b]Suger[/b], 1 tbsp [b]Oyster sauce[/b], and 1 tbsp [b]Soy sauce[/b], mix together.
Add the [b]Cashew nuts[/b] and mix well, until piping hot.
Serve
note: Great with either Chips or Noodles

title: Single Serve Double Chocolate Cookie
subtitle: When you only want to make 2 cookies
intro: A rich, chocolately cookie for one.
steps: Preheat the oven to 175c and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Set aside.
Place the 2 tbsp [b]Softened butter[/b] and 4 tbsp [b]Brown sugar[/b] in a medium bowl. Use a fork or a whisk to mix together until smooth and homogenous.
Scrape down the sides of the bowl and add the 1 [b]Egg yolk[/b] and 1/4 tsp [b]Vanilla extract[/b]. Mix until combined.
Scrape down the bowl and add the 1.5 tbsp [b]Cocoa powder[/b], 4 tbsp [b]Flour[/b], 1/8 tsp [b]Baking soda[/b] and 1/8 tsp [b]Salt[/b]. Mix until just combined and no streaks of flour remain.
Fold in the [b]Chocolate chips[/b] until evenly distributed.
Divide the [b]Cookie dough[/b] into 2 big [b]Cookies[/b] and place onto your prepared cookie sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake at 175c for 11 minutes or until the edges are set but the centers are still gooey.
Allow to cool for 10 minutes on the baking sheet until set.
Serve
note: Super quick and easy cookies

title: Garlic Turmeric Rice with Smoked Sausage
subtitle: Quick, easy, delicious
intro: Savoury garlic turmeric rice with bits of smoked sausage.
steps: Dice your [b]Onion[/b] and [b]Carrots[/b], set in a bowl, peel your [b]Garlic[/b] set aside.
Wash and rinse your [b]Rice[/b], set in a rice cooker, add the required amount of [b]Chicken stock[/b] for how much rice your making, and set to cook.

Meanwhile, in a frying pan set to medium high heat, add 1 tbsp [b]Oil[/b], and fry your diced [b]Onion[/b] and [b]Carrots[/b], for about 4-5 until softened, then add the [b]Grated garlic[/b] and fry for 1 minute. take off heat and set aside.
In the last few minutes the [b]Rice[/b] is cooking add in the 100g [b]Frozen peas[/b] and 100g [b]Frozen sweetcorn[/b], and mix gently.
Once the [b]Rice[/b] has finished cooking add the [b]Cooked veggies[/b] and mix together, dice up the 200g [b]Smoked sausage[/b], and add to the pot.
Leave the rice cooker on keep warm, and leave the [b]Cooked veggies[/b] and [b]Smoked sausage[/b] to come up to temperature.
Serve
note: Great with store bought prawn crackers.

title: Vegetable Ramen
subtitle: A warm, comforting bowl in just 15 minutes
intro: A comforting Japanese noodle soup filled with fresh vegetables, noodles, and a rich, savoury broth.
steps: Cut [b]Cabbage[/b], [b]Carrot[/b], [b]Onion[/b], [b]Pac choi[/b], and chop the [b]Scallion[/b].
Boil and peel your [b]Egg[/b]
In a large pot, add the 1 tbsp [b]Sesame oil[/b] and bring to a medium heat, once hot add in all the [b]sliced vegetables[/b] and stir fry for 2-3 minutes until slightly softened.
Add 570ml of [b]Chicken stock[/b], 1 tsp [b]Soy sauce[/b], and the [b]Ramen noodles[/b] directly into the pot.
Add grated ginger and black pepper if desired.
Let everything cook together for about 2 minutes, or until the [b]Noodles[/b] are tender.
Place the [b]Noodles[/b] and [b]Soup[/b] in a serving bowl, Garnish with chopped [b]Scallion, and drizzle with a little more [b]Sesame oil[/b] if you like, Top with a boiled egg
Serve
note: You can use a packet of instant ramen noodles or raw ramen noodles

title: No Bake Biscoff Cheesecake
subtitle: Creamy cheesecake with a Biscoff biscuit base
intro: Biscoff cheesecake with a creamy filling and crunchy biscuit base.
steps: Blitz the [b]Biscoff biscuits[/b] in a food processor until its a fine cumb, add the 75g [b]Melted butter[/b], and mix together, set 1/4 of the mixture aside for garnish later.
In a 7x3 inch springform pan add the [b]Biscoff butter mix[/b], press it down firmly, set in the fridge to chill while preparing the filling.
In a bowl, beat together 450g [b]Softened cream cheese[/b] and 240g [b]Softened biscoff spread[/b]. Beat just until smooth, about 20 seconds. Do not over mix.

Then add 250ml [b]Cold double cream[/b]. Beat until smooth. Pour batter in the [b]Chilled crust[/b]. Spread evenly. Tap to release excess bubbles. Place in the fridge for at least 5 hours or overnight.
Then when its chilled, top with [b]Melted biscoff spread[/b]. Tilt pan to spread evenly on top.  Chill again for 15 minutes to set.
Top with saved crust for garnish
Serve
note: Super easy, and absolutely delicious

title: Mary Berry's Sticky Toffee Pudding
subtitle: Warm toffee pudding with rich sauce.
intro: A moist date sponge drizzled in warm, buttery toffee sauce
steps: Preheat oven to 160c, and butter a shallow 1.7 litre ovenproof dish

Add 100g [b]Softened butter[/b], 175g [b]Brown suger[/b], 2 [b]Eggs[/b], 225g [b]Flour[/b], 1 tsp [b]Baking powder[/b], 1 tsp [b]Bicarb of soda[/b], 3 tbsp [b]Black treacle[/b], and 275ml [b]Milk[/b].
Beat together with a whisk for 30 seconds or until combined, pour into the prepared baking dish and bake for 35-40 minutes or until well risen and springy in the center.
For the [b]Sauce[/b], add to a saucepan, 100g [b]Butter[/b], 125g [b]Brown suger[/b], 1 tbsp [b]Black treacle[/b], 300ml [b]Double cream[/b], and 1 tsp [b]Vanilla extract[/b].
Stir over a low heat until the [b]Suger[/b] has dissolved and the [b]Butter[/b] has melted, then bring to a boil stirring for 1 minute.
Pour half the [b]Sauce[/b] over the cake in the baking dish and use as much of the leftover [b]Sauce[/b] as you want when grabbing a slice.
Serve
note: If you want you can add chopped Dates to the cake mixture.

title: Carrot Cake
subtitle: Moist carrot cake with creamy frosting.
intro: A spiced carrot sponge topped with smooth cream cheese frosting and a hint of cinnamon.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180c. Lightly grease two 9-inch round cake pans with baking spray or butter, and line the bottoms with parchment paper
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the 300g [b]Flour[/b], 2 tsp [b]Baking powder[/b], 1 tsp [b]Baking soda[/b], 1 tsp [b]Salt[/b], 1 tsp [b]Cinnamon[/b], and 1/2 tsp [b]Nutmeg[/b].
In a separate medium bowl, whisk together the 220g [b]Brown sugar[/b], 200g [b]White suger[/b], 320ml [b]Vegetable oil[/b], 4 [b]Eggs[/b], and 2 tsp [b]Vanilla extract[/b] until well combined.
Pour the [b]Wet ingredients[/b] into the [b]Dry mixture[/b] and stir together just until combined and only a few streaks of flour remain.
Fold the 315g [b]Grated carrots[/b] and 120g [b]Chopped pecans[/b] into the batter. Divide the batter evenly into the prepared pans.

Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Allow the cake layers to cool completely in the pans set on a wire cooling rack. Once cooled, invert the layers and remove the parchment paper.

In a large mixing bowl with a hand mixer or a stand mixer, beat 227g [b]Softened butter[/b] on medium speed until very soft and smooth, about 1 minute. Add the 225g [b]Cream cheese[/b] and beat until fluffy, about 30 seconds

With the mixer on low speed, gradually add in the 480-600g [b]Powdered sugar[/b]. (Use more sugar for a firmer, sweeter frosting.) Once combined, scrap down the bowl and add the 1 tsp [b]Vanilla[/b]. Beat on medium-low speed until fluffy and easily spreadable, about 1 minute.

Place one [b]Cooled cake layer[/b] top-side up on a cake stand or serving platter and spread some [b]Frosting[/b] over the top, all the way to the edge of the cake. Place the other [b]Cake layer[/b] top-side down on top. Spread the remaining [b]Frosting[/b] over the top and side of the cake.
Serve
note: You can top with extra chopped pecans at the end if desired.

title: Lentil Chilli
subtitle: A Delicious meat-free chilli
intro: A hearty lentil chilli packed with beans, vegetables, and warming spices.
steps: This recipe does not cover what to serve the dish with but it does pair well with Rice, or Chips.
Preheat the oven to 180c.
Heat a drizzle of [b]Oil[/b] in a large non-stick frying pan. Add the [b]Onion[/b] and fry on a medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the 1.5 tsp [b]Chilli powder[/b], 2 tsp [b]Paprika[/b], 2 tsp [b]Cumin[/b], 1 tsp [b]Garlic granules[/b], and 2 tbsp [b]Tomato puree[/b]. Fry for another minute.
Add the [b]Drained lentils[/b] with the [b]Tinned tomatoes[/b], can of [b]Black beans[/b], and 250ml [b]Stock[/b]. Season with [b]Salt & Pepper[/b] and give it a good stir.
Bring to the boil, then simmer on a medium heat for 7-10 minuets stirring regularly until the [b]Chilli[/b] has thickened.
Pour into an overproof dish, cover with the [b]Grated cheese[/b], then broil in the oven for 20-25 minutes.
Plate up a portion and serve with quartered [b]Cherry tomatoes[/b], some [b]Sweetcorn[/b], a dollop of [b]Sour cream[/b], and a pack of [b]Chilli doritos[/b]
Serve
note: Also goes well served with some sliced avocado.

title: Cozy Chicken & Dumplings
subtitle: A comfort food staple
intro: A comforting chicken soup with tender vegetables and fluffy homemade dumplings.
steps: In a dutch oven, cook [b]Chicken[/b] over medium-high heat until brown on both sides, Once [b]Chicken pieces[/b] are browned, remove and set aside.
Add diced [b]Carrot[/b] and [b]Onion[/b] and cook until just tender, about 3 minutes, Add [b]Chopped garlic[/b] and stir for another minute.
Reduce heat to medium-low and add 70g [b]Butter[/b] and 6 tbsp [b]Flour[/b], stirring constantly for 3 minutes to avoid lumps.
Add the cooked [b]Chicken[/b] and any accumulated juices back to dutch oven and stir to to coat in [b]Roux/Vegetable mix[/b].
Add 1400ml [b]Chicken stock[/b], 120ml [b]Cream[/b], 1/2 tsp [b]Dried thyme[/b], and 2 [b]Bay leaves[/b] and bring to a simmer. Once [b]Soup[/b] is at a simmer, add 220g [b]Frozen peas[/b] and cover.

In a separate bowl, combine 120g [b]Flour, 1/2 tbsp [b]Baking powder[/b], 1/4 tsp [b]Salt[/b], 1/4 tsp [b]Pepper[/b], and 150ml [b]Cream[/b]. Stir until mixture comes together into single mass of [b]Dough[/b].
Using a large spoon or ice cream scoop, form [b]Dough[/b] into small round balls about 1 inch in diameter (this dough mixture should yield 7-8 dumplings).
Place 7-8 [b]Dough balls[/b] into simmering soup (making sure they don’t touch), and cover. Let soup simmer for 15 minutes or until [b]Dumplings[/b] are cooked (they should pass the toothpick test).
Ladle into bowl, giving 1-2 [b]Dumplings[/b] per serving.
Serve
note: Can be made without the dumplings if you dont like them.

title: Simple Chicken Korma
subtitle: Creamy chicken curry with aromatic spices.
intro: A rich and creamy chicken korma with lots of flavour.
steps: This recipe is just for the chicken korma itself, but this dish goes great with Chips, or Rice.
Heat the 2 tbsp [b]Oil[/b] in a large frying pan over a medium heat, until hot.
Add the [b]Diced onion[/b] and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until softened.
Add the [b]Diced chicken breasts[/b] and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the [b]Chicken[/b] is sealed.

Add the [b]Grated garlic[/b], 2 tsp [b]Grated ginger[/b], 1 tsp [b]Ground cumin[/b], 1.5 tsp [b]Ground coriander[/b], 1.5 tsp [b]Garam masala[/b], 1/2 tsp [b]Chilli powder[/b], 1/2 tsp [b]Turmeric[/b], 1/4 tsp [b]Salt[/b], 1/4 tsp [b]White pepper[/b], and 2 tbsp [b]Tomato puree[/b].
Cook for 2 minutes, stirring, until the [b]Chicken[/b] is coated.
Add the 120ml [b]Yogurt[/b], 120ml [b]Coconut cream[/b], 2 tbsp [b]Ground almonds[/b], and 1 tbsp [b]Sugar[/b].
Stir everything together, bring to a gentle boil, then simmer for 6-8 minutes, until the [b]Chicken[/b] is cooked through.
Stir in the 60ml [b]Double cream[/b] and turn off the heat.
Serve
note: Great with Rice or Chips, and Naan breads.

title: Lentil Bolognese
subtitle: Lentil bolognese with hearty vegetables.
intro: A hearty lentil-based Bolognese simmered with tomatoes, herbs, and vegetables.
steps: This recipe is just for the bolognese itself and not any side, however this dish goes great with Spaghetti, Pasta, Rice, or Chips.
Finely chop 1 [b]Onion[/b], 1 rib [b]Celery[/b], 2 [b]Carrots[/b], and 3 [b]Garlic cloves[/b] with a knife or pulse them in a food processor.
Heat 2 tbsp [b]Olive oil[/b] in a large pot. Add the [b]Chopped vegetables[/b] and sauté for 3 minutes on medium heat, stirring often.

Add 2 tbsp [b]Tomato puree[/b], 200g [b]Grated mushrooms[/b] (grated with the large holes of a box grater), ½ tsp [b]Dried Rosemary[/b], 2 [b]Bay leaves[/b], 1 tsp [b]Salt[/b], 1/2 tsp [b]Black pepper[/b], and sauté for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Rinse the [b]Lentils[/b], then add to the pot, with 700g [b]Tomato passata[/b], and simmer for 20 minutes or until the [b]Sauce[/b] thickens.
Remove the 2 [b]Bay leaves[/b], stir in the 80ml [b]Milk[/b], and 60ml [b]Soy sauce[/b], then using a hand blender, blitz some of the [b]Sauce[/b] until you reach your desired texture.
Serve
note: great with spaghetti, pasta, rice, or chips
